hints.title: Separate the derivative into powers
hints.recap: A rational expression may become a sum of powers by dividing each numerator term by the denominator.
hints.pitfall: The minus sign outside the fraction changes the sign of both terms.
hints.pause: Check every exponent and coefficient before integrating.

recall.reminder: A rational expression may become a sum of powers by dividing each numerator term by the denominator.

hints.title: Integrate each power
hints.body: For n≠−1, an antiderivative of xn is xn+1n+1. Apply this separately to each term, then add an integration constant.
hints.recap: Increase the power by one and divide by the new power.
hints.pitfall: Negative exponents use the same rule; the new negative denominator can reverse a coefficient’s sign.
hints.pause: Find a formula for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></math> containing the unknown constant.

recall.reminder: Increase the power by one and divide by the new power.

hints.title: Fix the integration constant
hints.body: Substitute the given point into your antiderivative, including its integration constant.
hints.recap: An initial value determines the integration constant on the interval containing that input.
hints.pitfall: The point belongs to the function, not to its derivative.
hints.pause: Find the constant, then differentiate your final expression to check it.

recall.reminder: An initial value determines the integration constant on the interval containing that input.

solution:
First simplify the derivative to 3x2−2x−3+3x−2. Integrating term by term gives y=x3+x−2−3x−1+C.

At the given point, 5=1+1−3+C=−1+C, so C=6. Thus the offered formula is y=x3+1x2−3x+6.

Answer C. Differentiating it recovers the given derivative, and substituting x=1 gives 5.

The initial value fixes the constant on the positive-x interval. Because zero is excluded, an independently chosen constant could be used on the negative-x interval; the selected offered formula uses the same constant on both.
knowledgePattern: Integrate a rational derivative and fit an initial value
